{{Quote|Cruisers Nova and Farstar - pull in the rear guard. The enemy's taking the bait.|[[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR:MP" />}}
'''''Farstar''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that participated in the [[Battle of the Maelstrom]], the mission of which was to free [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] from the [[Maelstrom Prison]].<ref name="TOR:MP" />
